photos.name: img-7650
photos.summary: Loaf 1 cooling on a white cutting board after bake, S-shape score visible across a deeply browned, blistered crust with pockets of caramelized cheese and jalapeño peeking through. Dark crust ring of overflowed cheese rims the base.

photos.name: img-7652
photos.summary: Top-down view of loaf 1 showing the S-shape score open across the crown, flour-dusted ears framing a dark, glossy seam of melted cheese and jalapeño. Burnt cheese skirt fans out around the base.

photos.name: img-7654
photos.summary: Loaf 2 cooling on a wire rack just out of the oven, flour-dusted crust with an S-shape score opened to reveal caramelized cheese and a glimpse of green jalapeño. Lower profile than loaf 1, with the score sitting flatter across the top.

photos.name: img-7656
photos.summary: Cut interior of loaf 1 held in hand, showing an open, airy crumb with a concentrated band of melted cheddar and whole pickled jalapeño slices clustered through the center. Cheese and pepper distribution is uneven, pooled rather than dispersed.

photos.name: img-7648-frame-001
photos.summary: Motion-blurred video frame of loaf 1 in the Dutch oven on parchment just after the uncovered bake, S-shape score visible with golden-orange caramelized cheese pooling along the seam. Dark cheese leak ring already forming on the parchment.

photos.name: img-7648-frame-002
photos.summary: Loaf 1 in the Dutch oven on parchment, captured just out of the oven. S-shape score opened cleanly with deep amber-caramelized cheese pooled along the seam and dark cheese leak ring on the parchment.

photos.name: img-7648-frame-003
photos.summary: Side-angle frame of loaf 1 in the Dutch oven, flour-dusted crust with the S-shape score running diagonally across the crown. Caramelized cheese fills the open seam and pools onto the surrounding parchment.

photos.name: img-7648-frame-004
photos.summary: Close-up of loaf 1 still in the Dutch oven on parchment, S-shape score fully bloomed with glossy caramelized cheese filling the channel. Dark cheese leakage rings the base, parchment stained from sugars rendered out during the uncovered bake.
